title: Convolutional neural network based detection of early stage Parkinson's disease using the six minute walk test.
summary: A convolutional network classifies early Parkinson disease versus healthy control from six-minute-walk wearable signals, with measured performance on a specific clinical cohort.
ai_technology: 79 early-PD participants and 50 age-matched controls; gait sensor features and segment-wise classification accuracy are reported.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: A convolutional network classifies early Parkinson disease versus healthy control from six-minute-walk wearable signals, with measured performance on a specific clinical cohort.
evidence.unknown: Small single-center case-control evaluation; performance is diagnostic discrimination, not prospective screening or clinical benefit.
